levels.name: Street / platform level (Asema-aukio, station building, platform 1)
levels.note: No signposted level names found in any owner source. The station building (1935, Thure Hellström) stands on Asema-aukio on the town (south) side; track 1 platform is on the building side. Waiting room open daily 05:30-24:00.

answers.question: (no open-question list for Finland yet; brief priority 1: levels, which platforms have stairs/lifts, entrances, hours)
answers.answer: Two levels: street level (Asema-aukio, station building, track 1 platform side) and the Peltosaari underpass below the tracks. Platforms at tracks 1, 4, 5, 7, 8 and temporary 11 (Digitraffic, Wikipedia). OSM has one lift and one stair from the underpass to each island platform (4/5 and 7/8); Wikipedia confirms lifts renewed in 2018–2021. Waiting room 05:30-24:00 daily (VR). Only in-building shop: R-kioski.
answers._source: https://vr.fi/en/railway-stations-and-routes/riihimaki, read 2026-10-30; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Riihim%C3%A4ki_railway_station, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_fi/FI-RI.json), read 2026-10-30; Digitraffic infra-api laiturit via /home/claude/packs_fi/FI-RI/_report.json (Väylävirasto/Fintraffic, CC BY 4.0), read 2026-10-30

open: Level names: no owner source signposts names for the street level or the underpass.
Lift positions and whether track 1 / temporary track 11 platforms are step-free from the street: VR's page lists no lifts; positions are OSM only.

OSM platforms Ri0106 and Ri0156 carry internal refs, not track numbers. Ri0106 shares lift/stairs with platform 5, so it is probably the track 4 face of island 4/5; Ri0156 (reached by stairs w33189036 near the building) may be the track 1 platform. No source states this.

Restaurant in the station building: a yrittajat.fi event page names 'Riihimäen rautatieaseman ravintola Taco 4 Wine' at Asema-aukio 2, and Commons has a 2019 photo of a restaurant entrance in the station interior, but no current website or hours were found, so it is left out of amenities.
Toilet fee amount and hours not given by VR; fee=yes is OSM only.
Väylävirasto's station area map page (vayla.fi/vaylista/aineistot/kartat/asemien-lahialuekartat, linked from VR's station pages) could not be read (fetch error), so no plan is listed.
